method: Every crop is exact RGB equality to personally inspected original pixels. Every piece of every used tall source is bound by source and sheet SHA256 and exact placement/crop equality. No resizing, visual-similarity inference or unviewed sheets qualify.
scope: Complete28widgets (320/1200px, both themes), all56complete narrow statement/idea/caption/reference fields, all88unique narrow group modes and all106narrow critical plots plus complete readouts. Critical/mode qualification omits controls and legends; complete defaults cover them.
